CL-16
CLUTCH - CLUTCH UNIT
INSPECTION
1. INSPECT CLUTCH DISC FOR WEAR OR DAMAGE
Using vernier calipers, measure the rivet head depth.
Minimum rivet depth: 0.3 mm {0.012 In.)
lf necessary, replace the clutch disc.
2. INSPECT CLUTCH DISC RUNOUT
Using a dial indicator, check the disc runout.
Maximum runout: 0.8 mm (0.031 in.)
If necessary, replace the clutch disc runout.
3. INSPECT FLYWHEEL RUNOUT
Using a dlal indicator, check the flywheel runout.
Maximum runout: 0.1 mm (0.004 in.)
If necessary, replace the flywheel.
Torque: 49 N-m (500 kgf-cm, 36 ft•lbf)
4. INSPECT DIAPHRAGM SPRING FOR WEAR
Using vernier calipers, measure !he diaphragm spring for depth
and width of wear.
Maximum: ,-- A (Depth): 0.5 mm (0.020 In.)
B (Width): 6.0 mm (0.236 In.)
1' lf necessary, replace the clutch cover.

5. INSPECT RELEASE BEARING
Turn the bearing by hand while applying force in the axial direc­
tion.
HINT:
The bearing is permanently lubricated and requires no cleaning
or lubrication.
!f necessary, replace the release bearing.
